dedupe_keys.name: japan daily heatstroke ambulance dispatches and weather summers 2015 2019

description: This collection pairs daily heatstroke-related ambulance dispatches with maximum temperature and relative humidity across all forty-seven Japanese prefectures. Niigata University publishes a CSV and an R script for a two-stage time-stratified case-crossover analysis. The article specifies June–September observations for 2015–2019, providing national summer coverage at prefecture level. Zenodo distributes both files free under CC BY 4.0. The repository description emphasises the analysis script, while its inventory confirms a separate HSAD.csv data file. Aggregation across each prefecture, restriction to summer and focus on heatstroke are limitations for simulating total ambulance demand or individual journeys. Modellers could calibrate heat-related service-demand scenarios and examine capacity needs under temperature variation. model-jemss provides a related ambulance simulation environment, but linking prefecture-day counts to spatial calls would require additional assumptions. Neither the CSV nor the R script was downloaded, and the reported temperature associations were not reproduced or interpreted as validated causal effects.
name: Japan daily heatstroke ambulance dispatches and weather, summers 2015–2019
